description: Send a purchase order to its vendor by email (the PO as a PDF, with prices). A draft (status created) is issued first; an order already issued is sent again. An order that still needs a person's approval is not sent — issue_purchase_order sends it for approval instead. The email goes to the vendor's email address, or to emailTo when given; with neither, the call is refused. The preview shows the recipient, PO number, total and whether the order will be issued. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt.

emailTo.description: Optional address to send to instead of the vendor's email (one address).

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is sent until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

purchaseOrder.description: Purchase order id (GUID) or document number (e.g. PO-1042).

name: email_purchase_order
title: Email Purchase Order
